name: SharedWorkspaceTasks
description: A collection of the SharedWorkspaceTask objects in the current shared workspace site.
example:
Dim swsTasks As Office.SharedWorkspaceTasks
    Set swsTasks = ActiveWorkbook.SharedWorkspace.Tasks
    MsgBox "There are " & swsTasks.Count & _
        " task(s) in the current shared workspace.", _
        vbInformation + vbOKOnly, _
        "Collection Information"
    Set swsTasks = Nothing

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the SharedWorkspaceTasks object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the SharedWorkspaceTasks object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a SharedWorkspaceTask object from the Tasks collection of the shared workspace. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the SharedWorkspaceTasks object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the SharedWorkspaceTasks object. Read-only.

properties.name: ItemCountExceeded
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value that indicates whether the number of SharedWorkspaceTasks items in the collection has exceeded the 99 that can be displayed in the Shared Workspace task pane. Read-only.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Title As String, [Status As Variant], [Priority As Variant], [Assignee As Variant], [Description As Variant], [DueDate As Variant]) As SharedWorkspaceTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the list of tasks in a shared workspace. Returns a SharedWorkspaceTask object.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The title of the new task.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the new task. Default is msoSharedWorkspaceTaskNotStarted.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The priority of the new task. Default is msoSharedWorkspaceTaskNormal.

parameters.name: Assignee
parameters.description: The member to whom the new task is assigned.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the new task.

parameters.name: DueDate
parameters.description: The due date of the new task.
